messages:
Nia (Events): Heads-up: Tidewater conference joint webinar + on‑floor demo next Tue 11am PT. Need final speaker roster, demo kit ship ETA, and swag counts. Who can confirm?
Sam (Partnerships): I can own speaker confirmation. Planning to have Samir + Ravi on demo, Mia for product intro. Can we get bios by EOD Thu?
Ravi - Tidewater Systems: confirmed: Ravi (HW lead), Priya (edge infra), and Daniel (solutions). Shipping address for demo kit is our booth c/o Tidewater — I'll DM Lee.
Marta (Solutions): For the demo flow, we need a stable Redwood staging key and a preloaded dataset. Can eng provide a short-lived key and test account?
Sam (Partnerships): @DevDeployBot can we get a staging token + ephemeral endpoint for Tuesday? Also need 5 demo runs with ~2k tokens each.
DevDeployBot: Deployment request received. ETA for staging token: 18 hours. Will post token in #eng-runtime once ready (token will be expiring at event end).
Lee (Logistics): Swag inventory check: 150 hoodies, 300 stickers, 100 tabletop demo cards. Shipping timeline: packed Fri 9AM, courier pickup Sat. Need recipient phone in the shipping label.
Nia (Events): We need 2x extra demo GPUs in case of load. Can Dedicated team allocate burst capacity for the hour of the talk?
Sam (Partnerships): I'll request burst. Also, ask Tidewater to have an ethernet run and a spare HDMI. AV contact?
Ravi - Tidewater Systems: AV contact is Clara at +1-415-555-0132. We'll bring an ethernet switch and HDMI adapters.
Marta (Solutions): Run-of-show snippet (please copy into slides):
```
11:00 - 11:05  Intro + welcome (Nia)
11:05 - 11:15  Product overview (Mia)
11:15 - 11:30  Live demo (Ravi + Samir)
11:30 - 11:40  Customer story + Q&A (Daniel + panel)
```
Sam (Partnerships): Quick checklist: 1) Speaker bios (EOD Thu), 2) staging token (tomorrow), 3) demo kit shipped Fri, 4) swag manifest to customs if applicable.
Lee (Logistics): Shipping manifest: I'll add HS codes and commercial invoice. Anyone bringing personal laptops with local model copies? That affects customs.
Ravi - Tidewater Systems: We'll keep everything company-owned. No personal laptops.
Nia (Events): Rehearsal: can we do a 30m run Wed 9am PT? Prefer with audio/video + slide deck.
Sam (Partnerships): Wed 9am works for me. Can presenters join 10 min early for mic checks.
Marta (Solutions): One ask: record the demo session plus raw terminal output for post-event clips.
Sam (Partnerships): noted. @DevDeployBot post a calendar invite for Wed 9am with Zoom link and record enabled.
DevDeployBot: Calendar invite posted to everyone in thread. Recording enabled.
Nia (Events): Final swag ask—we had a partner request for 40 co‑branded stickers. Lee, can you reserve that subset and mark them on the manifest?
Lee (Logistics): Reserved 40 co-branded stickers. I'll attach the manifest link once labels are printed.
Sam (Partnerships): Action items summary: Speaker bios (Sam) / Staging token (DevDeployBot) / Ship kit + swag (Lee) / Rehearsal invite (DevDeployBot) / AV & contact (Ravi). I'll follow up with a 1‑pager for partners tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Nia (Events): Thanks all — very close. Please ping if anything blocks. :partyparrot:
